## About
Mike's Westside Auto is a neighborhood repair shop on Porter Road in Katy. We work on cars and trucks of all makes and models, and we aim to be fair on price and get you goin' fast.
Our mechanics are dedicated to high-quality repairs that keep you safe on the road. We only use parts from reputable brands, so your vehicle is ready to drive when you pick it up.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 199 reviews. One reviewer put it simply: the outside may not look great, but the best part is the people who work here.

## Services
- Oil change: Regular oil changes to keep your vehicle running right.
- A/C service: Come on in and get your A/C serviced.
- New tires and rotation: The rotation fee is waived when you buy new tires from us.
- Lift kits and OEM replacement: Stock OEM replacement parts or lift kits.
- Wheel repair: We repair damaged wheels.
- Windshield replacement
- Restore your headlight: We can make cloudy headlights look like new again.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my kind of vehicle?
A: We service all makes and models of cars and trucks.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Send us a message about what is going on with your vehicle, and we will get back to you soon with a quote.

Q: Should I call ahead to schedule?
A: One reviewer suggested talking with us about what date and time works best, especially if you need more than a regular oil change.
